_comment: Golden set for input/ — line totals computed by hand from the rate pack and the Camissa email (nett USD). null = the line must be unresolved. Line ids: s<seq> per quotation service, .r<n> per room line, .x<n> per 'Included' extra. Values are pinned; the confirmed/assumed split is the matcher's judgement and is not pinned (indicative is deterministic: validity vs travel dates). Read by `bun run costing.ts --check`.
